title: A market’s stall fee
bodyMd: A town cut its weekly market stall fee to attract craftspeople. More stalls were rented, but stall-fee revenue fell. The council considered the policy successful because its stated objective was to increase participation, not to maximize fee income. A shopkeepers’ association asked whether the extra stalls increased nearby shop sales. The council said it had no shop-sales data and would not use such a claim to defend the policy.
